recentItems.title: How Rhys McClenaghan Made Olympic History 🥇🇮🇪  Heartbreak at Tokyo 2020 to Gold at Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
Ireland's Rhys McClenaghan came 7th in the pommel horse at Tokyo 2020, only to come back stronger and claim the gold medal at Paris 2024, the first-ever gymnastics gold medal for Ireland!

recentItems.title: The New World Champions at the Artistic Gymnastics World Championships Rotterdam 2026 🤸‍♂️🇯🇵
recentItems.description:
Team Japan have shown up to podium practice at Rotterdam 2026 looking sharp and hungry for the medals. The men's team going on to claim their ticket for LA28 with a dominant showing as the new world champions. The Artistic Gymnastics World Championships take place from October 17th to 25th 2026, in Rotterdam Ahoy. Over nine days, the world’s best male and female gymnasts will compete for medals in team, all-around, and apparatus events! 

#Olympics #ArtisticGymnastics
